scientific_integrity: A complete analytical proof accompanies the theorem, with an independent exact-arithmetic finite example checker; computations supplement rather than imply the universal claim. Originality comparisons have a residual unindexed-literature risk.
scientific_limitations: Positive definite Hermitian coupling with spectrum at most 2; finite-dimensional state interval; fixed points and local exponential stability only, not general nonnormal couplings, global attractors, or periodic points.
title: Equilibrium rigidity and a sharp stability boundary in a Hermitian matrix logistic map
